entries.claim: The supplied checkout contains only OBDLSS5_SPEC.md and OBDLSS5_LUNA_PROMPT.md and is not a Git repository.
evidence: git status returned not a git repository

entries.claim: OBDLSS5 scope, profile, dependency candidates, frame contract, acceptance rows and mandatory fail-closed test policy.
The selected pinned Feeder architecture separates an x86 client from an x64 host and requires DLAA transport before a neural consumer can be evidenced.
entries.limitation: DeepWiki returned protocol version 1 while the specification's pinned feed_ipc.h evidence states version 9. The pinned specification is trusted for this implementation; no local upstream checkout was supplied to resolve the conflict.

entries.claim: The CLI uses Python standard-library argparse, pathlib, hashlib, json, subprocess and unittest-compatible patterns.
Offline unit and integration tests pass on the exact current source tree.

DFC 2.0.0, NVIDIA DLSS 310.9.1 and the experimental NVIDIA DLSSNR 310.8.SF-v2 runtime are hash-locked, deployed and loaded by the H0 host; the SF-v2 runtime passes Feature-18 neural creation/evaluation on the observed RTX 4090.
entries.limitation: The SF-v2 runtime is an external, experimental, unreviewed binary; the H0 result does not establish full game acceptance or redistribution permission.

entries.claim: The primary stack now has a real Oblivion run on the RTX 4090 with visible Feed status and same-run evidence of standalone DLSSNR initialization, Feature-18 creation and repeated successful neural frames; full A01-A12 acceptance remains incomplete.
entries.limitation: The stored screenshots are ON-state captures; a matched OFF/ON pair, visual verdict artifact, lifecycle matrix and full A01-A12 release gate are still required.

entries.claim: The selected classic Oblivion installation is PE32/I386; the mode=2 primary profile with DFC 2.0.0 and NGX runtimes was applied with an owned journal; the existing d3d9.dll.dxvk was preserved.
Feeder beta.4, dgVoodoo 2.87.5, ReShade Add-on 6.8.0, ReShade headers and the pinned LumeniteFX tree were retrieved from named sources and their local hashes are locked.

The primary x64 host H0 ran with DFC 2.0.0, NVIDIA DLSS 310.9.1 and experimental NVIDIA DLSSNR 310.8.SF-v2, identified the RTX 4090 and driver 616.92, reached DFC ARMED, created Feature 18, evaluated the neural feature successfully, and completed 300/300 synthetic evaluations.
entries.limitation: H0 proves the experimental runtime/DFC neural path on the synthetic host contract; it does not prove the real game startup path, visual quality or A01-A12 acceptance.
